meta.scope_judgement: 이 대본은 한국이 당사자인 침해·탈취 서사가 아니라 중국 대 인도·채무국의 제3국 간 자업자득 몰락 서사이며 한국은 관중석이다(concept.md 앵글). 따라서 「우리 쪽 얼굴 5장」 조항은 적용 범위 밖으로 판정하고, 양측 국가원수(시진핑·모디)로 세트를 세운 뒤 '승리 착지가 있으면 1장을 긍정형으로 전환한다'는 조항만 #3에서 이행했다. 대본에 한국 국가원수가 등장하지 않으므로 규칙대로 정치인을 끌어오지 않고 산업 현장 인물(반도체 클린룸 근로자)로 세웠다.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge as a single full-bleed image — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. Anything held or carried sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. photoreal current-affairs broadcast composite: every person, flag and location is a real photograph, sharp and true to life — faces keep real skin texture, pores, stray hair and natural shadow, and fabric keeps a visible weave. Over that photographic base sit broadcast graphic treatments: a bold colour field, cracked-glass shards, torn and dust-caked edges, a hard vignette and heavy atmospheric haze. Dramatic hard lighting, one dominant colour drowning the frame, every part of the upper five-eighths packed edge to edge with elements and no empty space, cinematic wide-angle, very high contrast. NOT an oil painting, NOT brushwork or impasto, NOT a matte painting, NOT anime, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3d render. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping (President of China) is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. Everything else is far smaller. An enormous Chinese flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars — fills the entire background from top to bottom as real woven fabric with a visible weave, deep hanging folds and photographic shadow, its lower edges frayed and torn into ragged strips, thick grey concrete dust caked into the folds, the red sun-bleached down to a dull grimy tone and the yellow gone chalky. Xi Jinping stands directly in front of that fabric, not beside it. Packed across the middle band in front of the flag stand seven motionless tower cranes with empty operator cabs and dead hooks, and behind them rows of bare concrete apartment frames whose window openings are black holes; a vertical column of drifting grey concrete dust rises through the frame and divides it. No fire, no flame, no orange glow anywhere — the dominant colour drowning the frame is ashen concrete grey. Xi Jinping's expression: his brow is furrowed deep with three hard creases, his eyes are cast down and unfocused past the cranes, his lips are pressed into a thin hard line with the corners dragged down, his shoulders are sunk, and no hand is anywhere in the frame. Hard raking daylight from a colourless winter sky lifts his face so it stays bright against the dark background. Do not invent any words or letterforms anywhere in the image. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no lower-third news banner, no watermark.
